clinicalSummary.clinical_context: 64-year-old female presented with right knee pain due to aseptic loosening of the right prosthetic knee. She underwent a single-stage revision arthroplasty and lateral retinacular release. Postoperatively, she completed 23 hours of IV antibiotics and was discharged home with instructions for wound care, physical therapy, and follow-up. Notably, she was restarted on levothyroxine for hypothyroidism.
secondary_diagnoses: Increased vascularity of thyroid suggestive of thyroiditis
procedures_performed: Single-stage revision arthroplasty for right prosthetic knee aseptic failure
Lateral retinacular release for realignment of extensor mechanism
Revision right knee arthroplasty with lysis of adhesions, PCL resection, posterior capsular release, and polyethylene exchange to a ultracongruent polyethylene size 9 mm
Left lower extremity squamous cell carcinoma excision
